skill.name: Shield Bash
skill.desc: Slams shield into the nearest enemy, dealing `[130% / 195% / 305%]` of ATK as Physical Damage and **stunning** the target for **1.5s**.

skill.name: Steady Shot
skill.desc: Fires a piercing arrow at the farthest enemy, dealing `[150% / 225% / 330%]` of ATK as Physical Damage.

skill.name: Fortify
skill.desc: Raises shield, granting self a `[220 / 380 / 600]` HP shield and granting all adjacent allies **+20 DEF** for **4s**.

skill.name: Haste Rune
skill.desc: Inscribes a rune beneath the ally with the highest Attack Speed, boosting their Attack Speed by `[30% / 45% / 70%]` for **5s**.

skill.name: Lance Charge
skill.desc: Charges the farthest enemy, dealing `[260% / 380% / 580%]` of ATK as Physical Damage and **knocking back** all enemies in the charge path by **1 hex**.

skill.name: Commanding Rally
skill.desc: Rallies all allies: grants `[250 / 430 / 800]` HP shield and **+20% / +30% / +50% Damage Amplification** for **6s**, and simultaneously **stuns all enemies** for **1s**.

skill.name: Warding Seal
skill.desc: Activates a runic barrier equal to `[180 / 310 / 490]` HP for **4s**, reflecting **15%** of incoming basic-attack damage while active.

skill.name: Quick Slash
skill.desc: Leaps behind the target, dealing `[140% / 205% / 320%]` of ATK as Physical Damage and generating **+15 Mana**.

skill.name: Time Lock
skill.desc: Fires a temporal orb at the nearest enemy, **pausing their mana generation for 3s** and dealing `[165% / 245% / 385%]` of AP as Magic Damage.

skill.name: Relic Aegis
skill.desc: Braces for impact, gaining `[25 / 45 / 70]` flat DEF and MDEF for **5s** and taunting the nearest enemy.

skill.name: Runic Cascade
skill.desc: Carves explosive sigils on the ground, dealing `[210% / 305% / 480%]` of AP as Magic Damage to all enemies in a **1-hex radius**.

skill.name: Colossal Smash
skill.desc: Slams both fists down, dealing `[255% / 375% / 580%]` of ATK as Physical Damage and **stunning all enemies** in a **2-hex straight line** for **2s**.

skill.name: Titan's Judgment
skill.desc: Smashes the ground with ancient power, dealing `[300% / 450% / 750%]` of ATK as Physical Damage to all adjacent enemies, granting self a `[300 / 500 / 900]` HP shield and **stunning** hit enemies for **2s**.

skill.name: Guarded Cleave
skill.desc: Swings halberd in a short arc, dealing `[130% / 195% / 305%]` of ATK as Physical Damage and gaining **+15 DEF** for **4s**.

skill.name: Gold Extract
skill.desc: Backstabs the target, dealing `[185% / 270% / 425%]` of ATK as Physical Damage. If it **kills** the target, gain **+1 Gold**.

skill.name: Noble Thrust
skill.desc: Pierces the target's vital spot, dealing `[220% / 320% / 500%]` of ATK as Physical Damage and **ignoring 30%** of the target's DEF.

skill.name: Midas Touch
skill.desc: Hurls a gilded elixir at the nearest enemy, dealing `[210% / 305% / 480%]` of AP as Magic Damage and **stunning** the target for **1.5s**.

skill.name: Bribe
skill.desc: Pelts the target with coins, dealing `[250% / 365% / 565%]` of ATK as Physical Damage and **disarming** the target (cannot basic attack) for **3s**.

skill.name: Gilded Blessing
skill.desc: Calls upon noble grace, healing all allies for `[20% / 35% / 70%]` of their **missing HP** and shielding each for `[250 / 430 / 800]` HP for **5s**.

skill.name: Hammer Strike
skill.desc: Smashes with a forge hammer, dealing `[140% / 210% / 325%]` of ATK as Physical Damage and **shredding** the target's DEF by **25%** for **4s**.

skill.name: Blackpowder Shell
skill.desc: Fires an explosive shell at the target, dealing `[170% / 250% / 390%]` of ATK as Physical Damage in a **1-hex blast** radius.

skill.name: Fortified Brick
skill.desc: Erects a barricade, granting self a `[280 / 460 / 750]` HP shield and granting all adjacent allies **+30 DEF** for **4s**.

skill.name: Iron Will
skill.desc: Enters an iron defensive stance, reducing **all incoming damage** by `[20% / 30% / 45%]` for **4s** and taunting the nearest two enemies.

skill.name: Sunder
skill.desc: Delivers a devastating strike, dealing `[260% / 380% / 590%]` of ATK as Physical Damage. Deals **+50% bonus damage** if the target has an active shield.

skill.name: Runic Armament
skill.desc: Enchants all allied units with runic plating, granting each a `[280 / 490 / 900]` HP shield. While shielded, units **reflect 30%** of incoming basic-attack damage.

skill.name: Acid Spit
skill.desc: Spews acid at the nearest enemy, dealing `[130% / 195% / 305%]` of AP as Magic Damage and **shredding** the target's MDEF by **25%** for **4s**.

skill.name: Frenzied Strike
skill.desc: Recklessly attacks the nearest enemy, dealing `[170% / 250% / 390%]` of ATK as Physical Damage and **restoring HP equal to 25%** of the damage dealt.

skill.name: Doom Edict
skill.desc: Seals a target's fate, dealing `[210% / 305% / 480%]` of AP as Magic Damage over **4s** (DoT). If the target **dies** during the effect, **summon a Skeleton Minion** (200 HP, 30 ATK).

skill.name: Abyssal Slam
skill.desc: Crashes down with twin axes, dealing `[255% / 375% / 580%]` of ATK as Physical Damage and **stunning** the target for **2s**.

skill.name: Demonic Circle
skill.desc: Tears open a shadow rift, summoning a **Demonic Sentinel** with `[350 / 600 / 1100]` HP and **30 base ATK** that absorbs enemy attacks and blocks the nearest hex to your backline.

skill.name: Tormenting Sweep
skill.desc: Teleports to the highest-HP enemy and sweeps a shadow scythe, dealing `[300% / 440% / 700%]` of ATK as Physical Damage. Enemies at or **below 20% HP** are **instantly executed**.

skill.name: Spark Shot
skill.desc: Launches a magic spark at the nearest enemy, dealing `[135% / 200% / 315%]` of AP as Magic Damage.

skill.name: Frostbite
skill.desc: Fires a frostbolt at the nearest enemy, dealing `[175% / 255% / 400%]` of AP as Magic Damage and **stunning** them for **1.5s**.

skill.name: Lightning Shield
skill.desc: Surges with electricity, gaining a `[220 / 370 / 600]` HP shield and dealing **60 Magic Damage** to any attacker that hits it while the shield holds.

skill.name: Mirror Image
skill.desc: Blinks to a random adjacent hex, leaving an illusion that taunts the nearest enemy and detonates for `[120% / 175% / 275%]` of AP as Magic Damage before vanishing.

skill.name: Spell Blade
skill.desc: Imbues weapon with arcane energy, dealing `[255% / 375% / 580%]` of AP as Magic Damage on the next basic attack and gaining **+30 DEF** for **3s**.

skill.name: Time Distortion
skill.desc: Tears open a temporal rift over the battlefield. All allies gain **+50% Attack Speed**. All enemies are **Silenced** and take `[350% / 520% / 850%]` of AP as Magic Damage over **4s**.

skill.name: Quick Arrow
skill.desc: Fires two rapid shots at the nearest enemy, dealing `[75% + 75% / 110% + 110% / 165% + 165%]` of ATK as Physical Damage per hit (total 150% / 220% / 330%).

skill.name: Vine Snare
skill.desc: Entangles the nearest enemy with vines, dealing `[155% / 230% / 360%]` of ATK as Physical Damage and **rooting** them in place for **2s**.

skill.name: Leaf Shower
skill.desc: Calls down a shower of sacred leaves, restoring `[180 / 310 / 495]` HP to the **2 lowest HP allies**.

skill.name: Blade Whirl
skill.desc: Spins dual blades in a close arc, dealing `[215% / 315% / 490%]` of ATK as Physical Damage and gaining **+20% Dodge Chance** for **4s**.

skill.name: Nature's Grasp
skill.desc: Erupts vines from the ground in a **2-hex straight line**, dealing `[225% / 330% / 515%]` of AP as Magic Damage and **silencing** all hit enemies for **2s**.

skill.name: Solar Arrow
skill.desc: Nocks a solar-charged arrow and fires at the lowest HP enemy, dealing `[300% / 440% / 720%]` of ATK as Physical Damage. Enemies **below 15% HP** are **instantly executed**.

skill.name: Jagged Swing
skill.desc: Swings a bone shard at the nearest enemy, dealing `[140% / 205% / 320%]` of ATK as Physical Damage and **restoring 80 HP**.

skill.name: Haunt
skill.desc: Phases through the battlefield to strike the backline target, dealing `[170% / 250% / 390%]` of ATK as Physical Damage and **silencing** them for **2s**.

skill.name: Toxic Cloud
skill.desc: Releases a putrid cloud centered on self, dealing `[185% / 270% / 425%]` of AP as Magic Damage to all nearby enemies and applying a **33% healing reduction** for **5s**.

skill.name: Grave Shield
skill.desc: Raises a shield of grave energy worth `[280 / 460 / 750]` HP. While the shield holds, adjacent enemies take **25 Magic Damage per second**.

skill.name: Soul Harvest
skill.desc: Reaps through the target, dealing `[260% / 380% / 590%]` of ATK as Physical Damage. If the target **dies**, the Reaper **restores 30% of its max HP**.

skill.name: Death Wave
skill.desc: Unleashes a wave of necrotic energy across the board, dealing `[290% / 430% / 700%]` of AP as Magic Damage to all enemies and **healing all undead allies for 250 HP**.

skill.name: Flame Ward
skill.desc: Cloaks self in flame, generating a `[140 / 240 / 380]` HP shield. While the shield holds, basic attacks deal an additional **+20 Magic Damage**.

skill.name: Ember Spit
skill.desc: Spits a fireball at the farthest enemy, dealing `[140% / 205% / 320%]` of ATK as Physical Damage and **burning** the target for **15 True Damage per second** for **5s**.

skill.name: Dive Strike
skill.desc: Swoops from above on a dive, dealing `[175% / 255% / 400%]` of ATK as Physical Damage and **knocking the target back 1 hex**.

skill.name: Dragon's Breath
skill.desc: Breathes a warm restorative wind, healing the **3 allied units** in the front rows for `[180 / 310 / 500]` HP each.

skill.name: Draconic Frenzy
skill.desc: Channels draconic fury, dealing `[255% / 375% / 580%]` of ATK as Physical Damage in a **cone** in front of the caster. Each enemy hit grants the caster **+8% Attack Speed** for **4s** (stacks per enemy hit).

skill.name: Inferno Breath
skill.desc: Rears back and unleashes a massive fire cone, dealing `[320% / 470% / 780%]` of AP as Magic Damage to all enemies in the cone and **burning** their **Max HP by 8% as True Damage** over **4s**.

skill.name: Dewdrop
skill.desc: Sprinkles healing dew, restoring `[130 / 225 / 360]` HP to the lowest HP ally.

skill.name: Spark Flare
skill.desc: Hurls a burning orb at the farthest enemy, dealing `[145% / 215% / 335%]` of ATK as Physical Damage.

skill.name: Splash
skill.desc: Launches a water orb at the nearest enemy, dealing `[170% / 250% / 390%]` of AP as Magic Damage and **delaying their next basic attack by 35%**.

skill.name: Hard Harden
skill.desc: Petrifies skin, gaining `[35 / 62 / 100]` flat DEF and MDEF for **5s** and **taunting** all enemies within 2 hexes.

skill.name: Wind Blade
skill.desc: Vanishes in a gust and reappears behind the target, dealing `[255% / 375% / 580%]` of ATK as Physical Damage and **knocking the target back 1 hex**.

skill.name: Tidal Fairy Wave
skill.desc: Commands all elemental energies, summoning a board-wide wave that deals `[280% / 415% / 680%]` of AP as Magic Damage to all enemies and **stunning** them for **1.5s**.
